notes.cap: HEZE that can ever be issued across every deck; a unit of account inside the files, never a token
notes.awayHours: the most time a deck will catch up on when you come back
notes.secondsPerDay: how long a day is, in real seconds
notes.sowCost: units drawn from the pile to sow a parcel by hand
notes.spreadCost: units drawn from the pile per parcel the continent spreads into on its own

text: The rulebook of the continent. Keep a changed copy in the browser through the editor in the quarter and the continent plays by it on its next load; write it into the yard and it plays by it for good.
